data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at the opening of the year were GBP 15.136m. Analysis of the claims development triangle shows net favourable development on prior underwriting years (2019 and 2020) totaling a release of approximately GBP 1.858m (about 12.3% of opening gross reserves). No explicit narrative quantifying prior year movement was provided; the PYD figure is calculated from the gross claims development table.
raw_causal_phrases: The provision for claims outstanding comprises amounts set aside for claims notified and claims incurred, but not yet reported (IBNR).
The provision for claims outstanding comprises the estimated cost of settling all claims incurred but unpaid at the balance sheet date, whether reported or not.

Whilst the Directors consider that the gross provision for claims and the related reinsurance recoveries are fairly stated based on the information currently available to them, the ultimate liability will vary as a result of subsequent information and events.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development amount was not stated explicitly as a gross movement; it was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (pages 34-35). The report does not provide a labelled 'movement in prior years' gross figure. Triangle and other amounts are presented in GBP '000 in the report. Mapping of 'Medical Malpractice' to the standard Lloyd's LOB 'Professional Lines' for lob_movements is an inference. The segmental table appears to show a small reinsurance premium (3k) which has been included to reconcile to the total premium figure.
